points.text: Pause opens as a field journal: leather cover, separate paper sheets, no center crease. Settings is a short list and a wider page. Inventory is two even sheets. Skills sits right of center. Confirms are a slip on top.
The vendor menu has its own stall front: wood posts, an olive awning, a name board, and a counter. The camp stall sprite stays on the building.
The dumpster menu is its own bin: a blue-grey rusted bin, lid open, bags in the mouth, Leave on a galvanized flap. The camp dumpster sprite stays on the prop.
The controls billboard is its own sign: wood frame, iron corners, a dark board, chalk title and bindings, Leave on a wood plank. The camp sign sprite stays on the prop.
The anvil menu is an iron anvil on a stump. The world sprite stays the prop, and the gear board stays.
The loadout menu is a cyan crystal on a dark stone pedestal, with pink stones at the front corners. The world sprite stays the prop.
The extraction gate is one page on the inventory board: stone, iron, and a cyan mouth, with worn slots, the bag, resources, and Send All.
Menus share one palette and one set of builders. An object frame skins that panel only; the other cream plates stay as they are.
A Build slice starts in a fresh worktree on the week branch. After gather it checkpoints, and a retry forks from that worktree.
Chroma key peels the magenta plate and the pink rim, and no longer treats a black or white border as plate.

entries.summary: Week 6 Grok Build snapshot. Pause is a field journal, camp menus wear their own fronts, and the extraction gate is one page on the inventory board.
